newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN FANS GET CROSS WITH LOSING TEAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN FANS GET CROSS WITH LOSING TEAM.

text.p: A groundsman at third division Viterbese turned up at the stadium on Wednesday to find 11 wooden crosses, each bearing the name of a team player, planted in the middle of the soccer pitch.
Police said disgruntled fans of the central Italian club, which had lost its last four matches, were presumed to blame. The metre-high crosses were immediately removed.
The players later ended their losing streak, beating Sicily's Juveterranova 1-0 in the afternoon, but team captain Massimiliano Nardecchia slammed the supporters.
"This is the sort of intimidation that cannot pass in silence. These so-called fans must be singled out and banned... we played with death in our hearts today," he said.
